title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI management system: the clauses this use case selects
description: The management-system standard chosen in the RAIMS use case. Conformity is the organisation's, never the software's.

requirements.title: AI risk assessment and treatment
requirements.text: Risks to the matter are identified and treated by named controls, and residual risk is stated.

requirements.title: AI system impact assessment
requirements.text: The organisation assesses impacts on people affected.

requirements.title: Documented information
requirements.text: The evidence for each run is generated and kept.

requirements.title: Operational planning and control
requirements.text: One versioned workflow and policy, recorded for every run.

requirements.title: Monitoring and measurement
requirements.text: Monitoring is computed from control evidence.

requirements.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirements.text: Failures are held, recorded and corrected by a named person.

requirements.title: AI system event logs
requirements.text: Events are logged in a tamper-evident ledger.

requirements.title: Data quality and provenance
requirements.text: Sources and documents carry their provenance.

requirements.title: Intended use
requirements.text: The system is used only as intended.

requirements.title: Allocating responsibilities
requirements.text: Responsibilities between provider and deployer are agreed.
